# Idempotence of compile runs

A compile run for the same repository and pull request (repo, pr) cannot be retriggered if it has already succeeded.

To prevent unnecessary compilations and maintain efficiency in the processing pipeline.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/schema.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.schema.CompileRun`
